value.text: {"result": {"suggestions": [{"kind": "existing_thesis", "pillar_id": "GOOGL.p3", "stance": "supports", "strength": 1, "wrong_if_met": false, "assumptions": [], "rationale": "Channel checks describe a draft Japan choice screen shown at setup and after major OS updates, with Search and Chrome as separate choices, which is a distribution-restricting remedy of the kind the pillar describes, though still a draft with the comment period open.", "claim_ids": ["synthetic_000223.c1", "synthetic_000223.c2", "synthetic_000223.c3"], "sections": [{"email_id": "synthetic_000223", "quote": "Three of five say they received a draft technical note via an industry body in the past two weeks describing how a search/browser choice screen would be presented on Android devices sold in Japan."}, {"email_id": "synthetic_000223", "quote": "Draft shows the screen at first device setup AND after major OS updates."}, {"email_id": "synthetic_000223", "quote": "Search and Chrome appear to be treated as separate choices in the draft (two OEMs; the others were unsure)."}]}, {"kind": "existing_thesis", "pillar_id": "GOOGL.p3", "stance": "contradicts", "strength": 1, "wrong_if_met": false, "assumptions": [], "rationale": "A view that Japan is a mid-single-digit share of Search revenue with stable default share suggests limited operating effect from this remedy, which bears on the pillar's wrong-if test, though it is an unconfirmed estimate and the test is not met.", "claim_ids": ["synthetic_000223.c6"], "sections": [{"email_id": "synthetic_000223", "quote": "Japan is a mid-single-digit share of Google's Search revenue by our estimate, and default share there has been very stable."}]}], "no_change_reason": null}}
